# Load libraries
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(destiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(gprofiler2)
```


# Load data
```{r}
seurat_obj <- readRDS(file = "seurat_objects/Postnatal_human_seurat_v5.rds")

seurat_obj
head(seurat_obj[[]])
```


Update metadata
```{r}
seurat_obj$cell_anno <- gsub("^Postnatal_human_", "", seurat_obj$cell_anno)

table(seurat_obj$cell_anno)
```



Check distribution of gene with low number of UMIs
```{r, warning=FALSE}
gene_umi_totals <- rowSums(GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts"))
```


Plot
```{r}
hist(gene_umi_totals[gene_umi_totals <= 100],
     breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10),
     main = "Genes with 1–100 UMIs",
     xlab = "Total UMIs per gene")
```




Filter out low abundance genes.
```{r}
# Define a threshold for the total UMI count
min_umi <- 10

# Calculate the total UMIs per gene
gene_totals_seurat_obj <- Matrix::rowSums(GetAssayData(seurat_obj, layer = "counts"))

# Subset genes with total UMIs above the threshold
seurat_obj
seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, features = rownames(seurat_obj)[gene_totals_seurat_obj >= min_umi])
seurat_obj
```




```{r}
# Subset only the lineage cells
lineage_cells <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = cell_anno %in% c("GN"))

table(lineage_cells$cell_anno)
```


# tSNE

```{r}
# 1. Normalize data
lineage_cells <- NormalizeData(lineage_cells)

# 2. Find variable features
lineage_cells <- FindVariableFeatures(lineage_cells)

# 3. Scale data
lineage_cells <- ScaleData(lineage_cells)

# 4. Run PCA
lineage_cells <- RunPCA(lineage_cells)

# 5. Elbow plot to help choose number of PCs
ElbowPlot(lineage_cells, ndims = 50)  # plots variance explained by top 50 PCs

# 6. Find neighbors using selected PCs (e.g., top 20)
lineage_cells <- FindNeighbors(lineage_cells, dims = 1:20)

# 7. Run clustering
lineage_cells <- FindClusters(lineage_cells, resolution = 0.2)  # adjust resolution as needed

```



```{r}
# Run t-SNE using the first 20 PCs
set.seed(123)
lineage_cells <- RunTSNE(lineage_cells, dims = 1:20)

# Plot t-SNE colored by seurat_clusters and samples
DimPlot(lineage_cells, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE)
DimPlot(lineage_cells, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "orig.ident", label = TRUE)
```


Save
```{r, eval=T}
# Open PDF device
pdf("harmony/tSNE_seurat_clusters_before_harmony.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)  # width & height in inches

DimPlot(lineage_cells, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE)

# Close PDF device
dev.off()
```



Save
```{r, eval=T}
# Open PDF device
pdf("harmony/tSNE_samples_before_harmony.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)  # width & height in inches

DimPlot(lineage_cells, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "orig.ident", label = TRUE)

# Close PDF device
dev.off()
```


```{r}
library(harmony)

# Run Harmony
lineage_cells <- RunHarmony(
  lineage_cells,             # Seurat object
  group.by.vars = "orig.ident",  # batch variable to regress out
  dims.use = 1:50             # PCA dimensions to harmonize
)
```



Calculate a tSNE plot.
```{r}
# Run t-SNE using the first 20 PCs
set.seed(123)
lineage_cells <- RunTSNE(lineage_cells, dims = 1:20, reduction = "harmony")

# Plot t-SNE colored by seurat_clusters and samples
DimPlot(lineage_cells, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE)
DimPlot(lineage_cells, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "orig.ident", label = TRUE)
```


Save
```{r, eval=T}
# Open PDF device
pdf("harmony/tSNE_seurat_clusters_after_harmony.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)  # width & height in inches

DimPlot(lineage_cells, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE)

# Close PDF device
dev.off()
```



Save
```{r, eval=T}
# Open PDF device
pdf("harmony/tSNE_samples_after_harmony.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)  # width & height in inches

DimPlot(lineage_cells, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "orig.ident", label = TRUE)

# Close PDF device
dev.off()
```




# diffusion map and pseudotime

```{r}

pcs <- Embeddings(lineage_cells, "harmony")[, 1:50]  # cells × PCs

# Run diffusion map
dm <- DiffusionMap(pcs)  # transpose: cells × PCs

# Compute pseudotime (DPT)
dpt <- DPT(dm)

# Assign to Seurat metadata
dpt_named <- setNames(dpt$DPT1, colnames(dm@transitions))
lineage_cells$DPT <- NA
lineage_cells$DPT[Cells(lineage_cells)] <- dpt_named[Cells(lineage_cells)]

```


Check diffusion pseudotime (DPT) distribution, using destiny, sometime the time order is reversed. 
```{r}
aggregate(DPT ~ seurat_clusters, data = lineage_cells[[]], summary)
```


```{r}
df <- data.frame(
  tSNE1 = Embeddings(lineage_cells, "tsne")[,1],
  tSNE2 = Embeddings(lineage_cells, "tsne")[,2],
  pseudotime_DPT = lineage_cells$DPT
)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = tSNE1, y = tSNE2, color = pseudotime_DPT)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "B") +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("tSNE colored by diffusion pseudotime")

p
```


Save
```{r, eval=T}
# Open PDF device
pdf("harmony/tSNE_DPT_after_harmony.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)  # width & height in inches

p

# Close PDF device
dev.off()
```



Plot: one younger and one older population?
```{r}
hist(lineage_cells$DPT,
     breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 0.1),
     main = "Pseudotime bined",
     xlab = "Pseudotime")

abline(v = 4, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
```

Save
```{r, eval=T}
# Open PDF device
pdf("harmony/histogram_DPT_outlier_after_harmony.pdf", width = 8, height = 5)  # width & height in inches

hist(lineage_cells$DPT,
     breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 0.1),
     main = "Pseudotime bined",
     xlab = "Pseudotime")

abline(v = 4, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)


# Close PDF device
dev.off()
```



```{r}
# Define a cutoff for pseudotime across all cells
cutoff <- 4  # replace with the DPT value you consider "too high"

# Flag cells above the cutoff
high_dpt_cells <- WhichCells(lineage_cells, expression = DPT > cutoff)

# Add a new metadata column
lineage_cells$DPT_outlier <- ifelse(Cells(lineage_cells) %in% high_dpt_cells, "outlier", "normal")
table(lineage_cells$DPT_outlier)

# Prepare dataframe for ggplot
df <- data.frame(
  tSNE1 = Embeddings(lineage_cells, "tsne")[,1],
  tSNE2 = Embeddings(lineage_cells, "tsne")[,2],
  pseudotime_DPT = lineage_cells$DPT,
  is_outlier = lineage_cells$DPT_outlier == "outlier"
)

# Plot, graying out outliers
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = tSNE1, y = tSNE2)) +
  geom_point(data = subset(df, is_outlier), color = "grey80", size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = subset(df, !is_outlier), aes(color = pseudotime_DPT), size = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "B") +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("tSNE colored by pseudotime (outliers grayed out)")

p
```


Save
```{r, eval=T}
# Open PDF device
pdf("harmony/tSNE_DPT_outliers_after_harmony.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)  # width & height in inches

p

# Close PDF device
dev.off()
```



# Subsampling

Reload original unfiltered data
```{r}
seurat_obj <- readRDS(file = "seurat_objects/Postnatal_human_seurat_v5.rds")

seurat_obj
head(seurat_obj[[]])
```




Update metadata
```{r}
seurat_obj$cell_anno <- gsub("^Postnatal_human_", "", seurat_obj$cell_anno)

table(seurat_obj$cell_anno)
```



Early GN DPT < 4 and late GN DPT > 4.
```{r}
meta <- lineage_cells@meta.data
meta$cell <- rownames(meta)

early_meta <- meta %>% 
  dplyr::filter(DPT < 4)

late_meta <- meta %>% 
  dplyr::filter(DPT >= 4)


nrow(lineage_cells)
nrow(early_meta)
nrow(late_meta)


#Randomly sample up to 300 barcodes per group
set.seed(123) # reproducibility

early_barcodes <- sample(
  early_meta$cell,
  size = min(300, nrow(early_meta))
)

late_barcodes <- sample(
  late_meta$cell,
  size = min(300, nrow(late_meta))
)

#should be zero
intersect(early_barcodes, late_barcodes)

early_GN <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = early_barcodes)
late_GN  <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = late_barcodes)

early_GN
late_GN
```

Update metadata
```{r}
# Copy metadata
meta <- early_GN@meta.data

# Replace "GN" with "early_GN" in the cell_anno column
meta$cell_anno <- ifelse(meta$cell_anno == "GN", "early_GN", meta$cell_anno)

# Assign updated metadata back to the Seurat object
early_GN@meta.data <- meta

# Check result
table(early_GN$cell_anno)
```



```{r}
# Copy metadata
meta <- late_GN@meta.data

# Replace "GN" with "late_GN" in the cell_anno column
meta$cell_anno <- ifelse(meta$cell_anno == "GN", "late_GN", meta$cell_anno)

# Assign updated metadata back to the Seurat object
late_GN@meta.data <- meta

# Check result
table(late_GN$cell_anno)
```


```{r}
# Subset to only the other lineage cells
seurat_obj_sub <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = cell_anno %in% c("NSC","INP","NB","YGN"))

seurat_obj_sub
table(seurat_obj_sub$cell_anno)
```


# Combining

```{r}
# Merge the two Seurat objects
combined_obj_GNxEarly <- merge(
  x = seurat_obj_sub,
  y = early_GN
)

# Check result
combined_obj_GNxEarly
table(combined_obj_GNxEarly$cell_anno)

#Join counts layers into one
combined_obj_GNxEarly <- JoinLayers(combined_obj_GNxEarly)

# Check result
combined_obj_GNxEarly
table(combined_obj_GNxEarly$cell_anno)
```

Save
```{r, eval=T}
saveRDS(combined_obj_GNxEarly, file="seurat_objects_harmony/Postnatal_human_seurat_v5_GNxEarly.rds")
```


```{r}
# Merge the two Seurat objects
combined_obj_GNxEarlyxLate <- merge(
  x = combined_obj_GNxEarly,
  y = late_GN
)

# Check result
combined_obj_GNxEarlyxLate
table(combined_obj_GNxEarlyxLate$cell_anno)

#Join counts layers into one
combined_obj_GNxEarlyxLate <- JoinLayers(combined_obj_GNxEarlyxLate)

# Check result
combined_obj_GNxEarlyxLate
table(combined_obj_GNxEarlyxLate$cell_anno)
```

Save
```{r, eval=T}
saveRDS(combined_obj_GNxEarlyxLate, file="seurat_objects_harmony/Postnatal_human_seurat_v5_GNxEarlyxLate.rds")
```


Check distribution of gene with low number of UMIs
```{r}
gene_umi_totals <- rowSums(GetAssayData(combined_obj_GNxEarly, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts"))

hist(gene_umi_totals[gene_umi_totals <= 100],
     breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10),
     main = "Genes with 1–100 UMIs",
     xlab = "Total UMIs per gene")
```


Filter out low abundance genes.
```{r}
# Define a threshold for the total UMI count
min_umi <- 10

# Calculate the total UMIs per gene
gene_totals_combined_obj_GNxEarly <- Matrix::rowSums(GetAssayData(combined_obj_GNxEarly, layer = "counts"))

# Subset genes with total UMIs above the threshold
combined_obj_GNxEarly

combined_obj_GNxEarly <- subset(combined_obj_GNxEarly, features = rownames(combined_obj_GNxEarly)[gene_totals_combined_obj_GNxEarly >= min_umi])
combined_obj_GNxEarly
```


```{r}
Idents(combined_obj_GNxEarly) <- "cell_anno"

VlnPlot(
  combined_obj_GNxEarly,
  features = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA"),
  pt.size = 0.1,            # size of points
  ncol = 2                  # plot side by side
)
```


Save
```{r, eval=T}
saveRDS(combined_obj_GNxEarly, file="seurat_objects_harmony/Postnatal_human_seurat_v5_GNxEarly_filtered.rds")
```
